title: Manufar Sirri
description: Waɗanne bayanai I Need Save ke sarrafawa idan ka yi amfani da wannan shafin, waɗanne kukis da kayan nazari yake amfani da su, da haƙƙoƙinka kan bayananka na sirri.
body:
I Need Save (ineedsave.com) kayan aiki ne na kyauta don sauke bidiyo, hotuna da sauti daga kafofin sada zumunta, wanda Abid Hanan Wicaksono ke gudanarwa. Wannan manufa tana bayyana irin bayanan da muke sarrafawa idan ka yi amfani da wannan shafin yanar gizo da kuma yadda muke kula da su. Da gangan muke tattara mafi ƙarancin bayanan da zai yiwu: ba ka buƙatar yin rajista, shiga, ko bayar da sunanka ko imel ɗinka don amfani da sabis ɗin.

Bayanan da muke sarrafawa

  • Link ɗin da ka liƙa. Ana aika link zuwa sabar mu ne kawai don nemo media da za a iya saukewa. Ba ma ajiye link a cikin rumbun bayanai, kuma ba ma haɗa su da shaidarka.
  • Fayilolin media. A duk lokacin da zai yiwu, burauzarka tana sauke fayil kai tsaye daga sabar ainihin dandamalin (misali Instagram, Facebook ko X). Idan dole ne a sarrafa fayil (misali, haɗa bidiyo da sauti ko mayar da shi MP3), ko kuma idan dandamalin bai yarda a sauke kai tsaye ba, ana kwararo shi ta sabar mu zuwa na'urarka ba tare da an ajiye shi ba.
  • Bayanan fasaha. Kamar kusan kowane shafin yanar gizo, kamfanin da ke ɗaukar nauyin shafinmu (Vercel) yana adana bayanan fasaha na buƙatu, kamar adireshin IP, nau'in burauza da lokacin shiga, don tsaro da gudanarwa. Ana ajiye waɗannan bayanai na ɗan lokaci kawai bisa manufofin Vercel.
  • Ƙididdigar maƙaloli. Ana ajiye adadin kallo, so da rabawa a matsayin jimla ga kowace maƙala, ba tare da wani bayani da zai bayyana ko kai wane ne ba.

Kukis da ma'ajiyar burauza

  • ins-lang: yana tuna harshen da ka zaɓa, na tsawon shekara ɗaya.
  • dl_…: kuki na wucin gadi mai ɗaukar 'yan daƙiƙoƙi wanda ke nuna cewa an fara saukewa.
  • Ma'ajiyar gida (localStorage da sessionStorage): tana tuna maƙalolin da ka so kuma tana hana a ƙirga ziyara ɗaya sau biyu. Waɗannan bayanai suna zama a na'urarka.
  • Kukis na nazari na ɓangare na uku daga Google Analytics da Microsoft Clarity, kamar yadda aka bayyana a ƙasa.

Nazari

Muna amfani da kayan aikin nazari don fahimtar yadda ake amfani da shafin da kuma inganta shi:

  • Vercel Web Analytics: ƙididdigar ziyara ba tare da bayyana ko su wane ne masu ziyara ba, kuma ba tare da kukis ba.
  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): yana amfani da kukis don auna shafukan da ka buɗe, ƙiyasin ƙasar da kake, nau'in na'urarka, da abubuwan da suka faru kamar danna maɓallan saukewa. Google ne ke sarrafa bayanan bisa Manufar Sirri ta Google.
  • Microsoft Clarity: ana loda shi da zarar ka fara mu'amala da shafin. Clarity yana naɗar mu'amala kamar dannawa da gungurawa don taswirar zafi (heatmaps) da naɗar zaman amfani, kuma yana ɓoye abin da ka rubuta a cikin filayen shigarwa. Microsoft ne ke sarrafa bayanan bisa Bayanin Sirri na Microsoft.

Za ka iya ficewa daga nazari ta hanyar toshe kukis na ɓangare na uku a saitunan burauzarka, amfani da mai toshe masu bin diddigi, ko shigar da Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Shafin zai ci gaba da aiki gaba ɗaya.

Ayyukan ɓangare na uku

  • Vercel Inc. ne ke ɗaukar nauyin shafin (hosting). Sabarsa na iya kasancewa a wajen ƙasarka.
  • Google Fonts ana amfani da shi don nuna wasu rubuce-rubucen haruffa (misali Larabci, Thai ko Japananci). Idan aka loda font, adireshin IP ɗinka yana bayyana ga Google.
  • Ainihin dandamalin media ɗin. Idan aka sauke fayil kai tsaye, wannan dandamalin zai iya ganin adireshin IP ɗinka, kamar yadda yake idan ka buɗe abun cikin da kanka.
  • Maɓallan rabawa (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) suna tuntuɓar waɗannan ayyuka ne kawai idan ka danna su.

Tsaro da rabawa

Duk haɗi zuwa wannan shafin yana amfani da HTTPS. Ba ma sayarwa, ba da haya ko musayar bayanan sirri. Ana raba bayanai ne kawai da masu ba da sabis da aka ambata a sama, gwargwadon abin da ake buƙata don gudanar da shafin, ko kuma idan doka ta buƙata.

Yara

Ba a yi wannan sabis don yara 'yan ƙasa da shekara 13 ba, kuma ba ma tattara bayanan sirri daga yara da sani.

Haƙƙoƙinka

Ya danganta da inda kake zaune (misali a ƙarƙashin Dokar Kare Bayanan Sirri ta Indonesiya, Doka Lamba 27 ta 2022, ko Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Gaba ɗaya ta Tarayyar Turai (GDPR)), kana iya samun haƙƙin samun dama ga bayananka na sirri, gyara su ko share su, da kuma janye izinin da ka bayar na sarrafa su. Saboda kusan ba ma ajiye wani bayani da zai bayyana ko kai wane ne, yawancin buƙatu za a iya biyan su kawai ta hanyar share kukis a burauzarka. Don bayanan da Google ko Microsoft ke sarrafawa, za ka kuma iya amfani da saitunan sirri na ayyukansu. Don duk wani abu dabam, tuntuɓe mu.

Canje-canje ga wannan manufa

Ana iya sabunta wannan manufa lokaci zuwa lokaci. Canje-canje suna fara aiki da zarar an wallafa su a wannan shafin, tare da ranar fara aiki da aka nuna a sama.

Tuntuɓe mu

Ana iya aiko da tambayoyi game da wannan manufa ta hanyoyin tuntuɓa da ke ƙasan kowane shafi ko ta abidhanan.my.id.
